mcqs.learning_point: Understand that parallel lines remain equally separated
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly describes the relationship between two parallel lines when they are extended indefinitely?

options.A: They gradually get closer to each other
options.B: They intersect at some distant point
options.C: They stay the same distance apart everywhere
options.D: They are always perpendicular to each other

mcqs.answer: They stay the same distance apart everywhere
mcqs.explanation: Parallel lines are defined as lines in the same plane that never meet, no matter how far they are extended. This means the perpendicular distance between them remains constant, so option C is correct. Options A and B describe intersecting lines, and D describes perpendicular lines, not parallel ones.

mcqs.learning_point: Recognise parallel lines in geometric figures
mcqs.question: In rectangle ABCD, which pair of sides are parallel to each other?
mcqs.explanation: A rectangle has opposite sides that are equal and parallel. Therefore side AB is parallel to side CD, and side BC is parallel to side AD. Option B correctly identifies one pair of parallel sides. The other options pair adjacent sides, which meet at right angles.

mcqs.learning_point: Identify examples of parallel lines in everyday objects
mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT an example of parallel lines?

options.A: The two rails of a railway track
options.B: The opposite edges of a ruler
options.C: The two long sides of a ladder
options.D: The two edges of an open book

mcqs.answer: The two edges of an open book
mcqs.explanation: When a book is opened, its front and back covers form an angle, so the edges diverge and are not parallel. The rails of a train, opposite edges of a ruler, and the long sides of a ladder all remain the same distance apart, making them parallel. Hence option D is the correct choice.

mcqs.learning_point: Distinguish parallel lines from intersecting lines
mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes parallel lines from intersecting lines?

options.A: Parallel lines intersect at right angles
options.C: Parallel lines are coplanar and never meet, no matter how far they are extended

mcqs.answer: Parallel lines are coplanar and never meet, no matter how far they are extended
mcqs.explanation: Parallel lines lie in the same plane (coplanar) and, by definition, never intersect, regardless of how far they are extended. Intersecting lines, by contrast, meet at a point. Options A and D describe perpendicular relationships, and B is the opposite of the definition of intersecting lines. Therefore, option C accurately distinguishes the two concepts.
